title: Modeling Subjectivity in Cognitive Appraisal with Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on psychological cognitive appraisal and modeling individual subjectivity. While it evaluates appraisal dimensions like social norms and personal standards, these are treated as descriptive psychological categories rather than a benchmark of the model's moral reasoning, ethical frameworks, or religious values. The Ethical Considerations section is a procedural disclosure and not a core research component.
